The long omits the short's role and product-development bundle: it explains the proposed New York move, specific one-year leave from Milan legal practice and her father's contemplated sale, then adds foundation creation and practical early childhood provision. long_biography.plain_text:
Giovanna Vitelli took a year's leave from legal practice in Milan to join her father's Azimut Benetti business. She had been preparing for a move to New York when Paolo Vitelli told her he was considering a sale. The temporary arrangement became a lasting commitment to the company.

In 2025, she established Fondazione Paolo Vitelli and became its president, continuing her father's community work. The foundation supports Scuola Picco Zerosei in Avigliana, an early childhood centre serving local families and those of group employees. Its provision spans nursery and preschool education, bringing care for babies and young children into the same centre.
long_biography.html:
Giovanna Vitelli took a year's leave from legal practice in Milan to join her father's Azimut Benetti business. She had been preparing for a move to New York when Paolo Vitelli told her he was considering a sale. The temporary arrangement became a lasting commitment to the company.

In 2025, she established Fondazione Paolo Vitelli and became its president, continuing her father's community work. The foundation supports Scuola Picco Zerosei in Avigliana, an early childhood centre serving local families and those of group employees. Its provision spans nursery and preschool education, bringing care for babies and young children into the same centre.
